entry.title: Hot off the Press: The Genomic Code: The Genome Instantiates a Generative Model of the Organism
entry.content:
Authors: KJ Mitchell, N Cheney - Proceedings of the Genetic and Evolutionary ..., 2026

Abstract: The genome is often described through metaphors like blueprint or recipe, but these frameworks fail to capture the dynamic complexity of biological systems. This paper emphasizes a more robust analogy: the genome as a generative model. Drawing ...
